crossRefs.note: I gave you your master’s house, and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah…
Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and…
The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.
His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female…
